answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations, bound to Semaphore identities, produce rate-limit proofs and nullifiers. A repeated message in the same epoch reuses a nullifier; the distinct evaluations then act as Shamir shares, exposing the agent’s private key. Verification triggers immediate collateral slashing, making Sybil identities costly rather than a marble, basalt, or river of free accounts.
